description: The ENCORE project deposits building-renovation activity and progress data collected during Automated Work Planning Services tests. Zenodo lists one public activities CSV and nine short progress JSON files under CC BY 4.0. The provider dates progress observations between 14 March and 11 April 2022 and the broader renovation work between 7 March and 11 April. A construction modeller could compare simulated task completion or schedule slippage against the recorded activity states. The files describe one demonstration building, not a representative sample of renovation projects or a completed construction schedule for every day. The own page does not define all activity codes, progress percentages, dependencies or how the JSON relates to the separate crew-status and AWOPS-workplan deposits. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these status observations. The small CSV and JSON files were not downloaded, so join keys, missing days and actual task completion remain unverified.
name: Building status collected during AWOPS tests
notes: G6 item G6-2289. Metadata-only draft. Simulation-use and type tags are reviewer classifications. File contents and software execution were not checked. Unknown maturity does not assert active maintenance.
